_about: Forestry (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Forestry). Recorded values are from rsprox 227/00083, 01723, 01850, 01855 and 237/01098 (Leagues worlds, so their XP and bark are inflated and not used); Wiki values are marked; calibrated ones are guesses.
_trees: Wiki: overworld trees except regular, burnt, hollow, player-grown, blisterwood and the Woodcutting Guild's. Achey and Dramen trees are left out too (calibrated).
_spawn: Wiki: an event needs a forestry kit among the choppers, none within 30 tiles of another, 40-120 s between events; rewards need a chop within 30 tiles in the last 3 minutes. Recorded: the first event 19-29 ticks into chopping, a log the tick before each spawn, the spawn stops the chopping. Wiki: an event comes at a random point on the tree's timer, or when it falls. Calibrated: 20-200 ticks of chopping before an event unless the tree falls first, and the 40-120 s buffer as 67-200 ticks from the end of the last.

sapling._progress: Wiki: the sapling's max HP is 900 a player, at most 9,000; recorded: the hitsplat is 0.6 x the nutrition, success after 16 full feeds solo.
sapling._feed: Units per nutrition, as the recorded bark and XP scale (10/20/40/50/60/70/100 -> 1/2/4/5/6/7/12); bark is units less 0-1 (recorded 3, 4, 6-7, 11-12; Wiki 1-12). XP at 100% (Wiki): Woodcutting 1.9-2.2 x level, Farming 0.6-0.8 x level, scaled by units/12.
sapling._lump: Wiki: bonus bark by average nutrition; recorded 177, 162, 191. Bonus XP is calibrated (the Wiki's formula is garbled): 50 x level x average nutrition. Leaves: Wiki 15-20 of the tree's tier.

roots._recorded: rsprox 227/01850 t7914-8113: six roots at the start within 4 tiles, a wave of 2-4 every 27 ticks with one anima root from the second on, the despawn anim 21 ticks after spawning, gone with the next wave, the last at 199 ticks; Chop down gives 'You swing your axe at the roots.'
roots._rewards: Wiki: normal roots 2-3 bark (Woodcutting 15-40) or 3-4 (41+), anima roots 8-10 or 11-13; XP 0.55 x level a normal root, 1.2 x level an anima root. Calibrated: a root goes on its first success, chopped at the willow's chance.

pheasant._recorded: rsprox 227/00083 t19147-19347, 01855 t7421-7621, 237/01104: the Freaky Forester, three pheasants and four nests (nest01 49936 / nest02 49937, each flipping every 8 or 12 ticks), Retrieve-egg on a nest with the pickup seq, one egg at a time, half the time a feather too, the attack and stun, the hand-in, 'These pheasants will be finding new nesting grounds soon.' at 181 ticks, all gone at 200. Wiki: 8-9 bark an egg (9 at 9/10), Woodcutting 1.0-1.2 x level and Thieving 0.5 x level an egg. Inferred: nest01 is the occupied form; clicking it, or the nest a pheasant is flying to, brings the attack.

poachers._recorded: rsprox 227/01855 (six runs), 00083: the fox and three poachers, a trap within two tiles of the fox every 12-14 ticks, living 13-15 ticks, the disarm (9 ticks), the spring (the fox's defend seq, a 34 hitsplat), the end at 200 ticks with the poachers' lines and the gift. Wiki: up to 15 traps, a sprung trap takes 33-34 of the fox's 100 HP, 11 bark a trap, Woodcutting 1.5 x level and Hunter 0.5 x level a trap, 160 bark and 400 + 14.45 x level Woodcutting XP at the end, and the failure line.

ritual._recorded: rsprox 227/01850 t6292-6535 (8 of 8 steps), 01855, 01723 (4 steps): the Dryad, five ritual circles within 3 tiles a step, the odd one (its colour and its shape both unique among the five) to stand on, a step every 30 ticks scored at 27, the end after eight. Wiki: 20-21 bark a step, 2 x level + 60 XP a step, 2 x steps x level + 55 at the end; recorded lumps 143/144 for 8 steps and 72 for 4 (about 18 a step).

flowering._recorded: rsprox 227/00083, 01850, 237/01104 and 01108: eight bushes (each its own colour) and two bee npcs; Tend-to with the pickup-table seq; exactly two bushes active at once as a pair that changes over the event (no packet shows which); pollen from one, applied to the other, then back, a bark each time; a bush fruits; the end at 300 ticks with the dormant line, the pollen discarded, and a lump the next tick that grows with the fruiting bushes. Wiki: five iterations (four of 43 s, a last of 8 s), 1-2 bark an exchange, the lump about 0.75-0.85 x the bark collected, 1-8 strange fruit; a pair fruits with at least one exchange. Calibrated: XP (the Wiki's formula is garbled) as 0.2 x level + 2.8 an exchange and 10 x level a fruiting bush at the end.
flowering._iterations: Fitted to the recorded 300 ticks from the first pair at 18 (the Wiki's four of 43 s and a last of 8 s, scaled).

entlings._recorded: rsprox 237/01104, 227/01723, 237/01098: five entlings with their requests overhead, Prune's menu (Top/Back/Sides/Cancel) and Prune-top/-back/-sides, 'You prune the entling.' with the pruning seq and bark a prune, 10-22 prunes an entling, the pruned form and its thanks, the stun for pruning it again or the wrong cut, 'Almost time to go!' at 155, the end at 200 with the gift. Wiki: the leafy mullet is top and sides; 4-5 bark a prune; XP 0.5 x Woodcutting and 0.2 x Fletching level a prune; 25 bark, 4 leaves and 3 x level Woodcutting XP for each fully pruned entling at the end; a 3 s stun. Calibrated: 10-20 prunes an entling, split over the areas it wants.

beehive._recorded: rsprox 227/01855 (two runs), 237/01104, 01098: the bee keeper ('Oh, Bees!'), an unfinished beehive and the wild one, two bee npcs; Build adds logs one every two ticks with the pickup seq, filling headbar 17 by 12 of 60 a log (five logs solo); the box changes at 36 and is complete at 60; the completion line, then a bark lump the next tick, sometimes sturdy beehive parts; a new box within 3 tiles with a smoke puff, the old one gone 4 ticks on; the keeper's lines; over at 250 ticks. Wiki: 5 logs a player (at most 50) a hive; 2-3 bark a normal log, 4-5 an oak, 5-6 better; Woodcutting 40% / 55-60% / 75-80% and Construction 20% / 30% / 40% of level a log by the same tiers; 25-30 bark and 5.45x - 0.02x^2 Woodcutting XP a hive; parts 2/3 of the time.

lines.done: Come with me little bees I'll keep you safe.
rehome: I'll find a nice new home for those bees.
lines.bye: Well, I must be getting on now.

leprechaun._recorded: rsprox 227/01850 t8623-8847 (and 00083, 01723, 01855, 237/01104, 01098): the Woodcutting Leprechaun on a clover by the tree ('It be yer lucky day, Foresters!'); a rainbow loc within 1-9 tiles every 37 ticks from the first tick, gone 17-20 ticks later (its despawn anim 3 ticks before); standing in one: 'You feel more in touch with the trees after standing in the rainbow.' and +12 to varbit 15344 (the luck, 1 at login), its slot in 15343; each log then spends 5 of it: 'You use your leprechaun's luck to gather some Anima-infused bark.' (the last: 'You use the last of your leprechaun's luck...') and 22-23 bark; Talk-to and Bank (the menu, the deposit box, 'Some of your items cannot be stored in the bank from here.'); 'I'll have to go shortly...' at 186, 'Well, I must be getting on now.' at 223, gone at 224 with the luck drained. Wiki: six rainbows; a luck log's XP about 1.33 x level + 38.7 more [confirmation needed]; he banks everything for those who were chopping, else only woodcutting resources.
